subject: 3rd Grade Parent-Teacher Conference Signups - November 4-8
text_body:
Dear 3rd Grade Families,

It's time to schedule our fall parent-teacher conferences! This is an important opportunity for us to discuss your child's progress, strengths, and areas for growth.

CONFERENCE WEEK: November 4-8, 2026
Each conference is 20 minutes long.

HOW TO SIGN UP:
1. Visit our online signup page at: https://lincolnelementary.ptcfast.com
2. Select "3rd Grade - Mrs. Chen"
3. Choose an available time slot
4. You will receive a confirmation email with your scheduled time

AVAILABLE TIME SLOTS:
Monday 11/4: 1:00 PM - 4:00 PM
Tuesday 11/5: 1:00 PM - 4:00 PM
Wednesday 11/6: 1:00 PM - 7:00 PM (evening slots available)
Thursday 11/7: 1:00 PM - 4:00 PM
Friday 11/8: 8:00 AM - 12:00 PM

DEADLINE: Please sign up by Friday, November 1 so I can finalize the schedule.

NOTE: Students will have minimum days all week (dismissal at 12:30 PM) to accommodate conferences. Kids Club will be available for extended care.

If none of the available times work for you, please email me directly and we can arrange an alternative.

I look forward to meeting with each of you!

Warmly,
Mrs. Patricia Chen
3rd Grade Teacher
Lincoln Elementary School
pchen@lincolnelementary.edu
